statements.t: We believe our strategy will allow us to continue to deliver high quality, affordable education, resulting in continued growth over the long-term.
We will continue to invest in this strategy to strengthen the foundation and future of our business.
The Company intends to defend against these claims vigorously and is unable to predict the outcome or financial impact of this proceeding at this time.

On an ongoing basis, management evaluates its estimates and judgments related to its allowance for credit losses; income tax provisions; the useful lives of property and equipment; redemption rates for scholarship programs and valuation of contract liabilities; fair value of right-of-use lease assets for facilities that have been vacated; incremental borrowing rates; valuation of deferred tax assets, goodwill,…

If the financial condition of our students were to deteriorate based on current or expected future events resulting in evidence of impairment of their ability to make required payments for tuition payable to us, additional allowances or write-offs may be required.

We believe that the most critical assumptions and estimates used in determining the estimated fair value of the ANZ reporting unit include the amounts and timing of expected future cash flows, revenue growth, operating margins, the discount rate, the terminal growth rate, and, for the market approach, the selection of guideline public companies and their related revenue multiples.
Management will continue to assess these assets for impairment in future quarters.
We also periodically review our assumed forfeiture rates and ability to achieve performance targets for stock-based awards and adjust them as necessary.
